title: Identify the affine-space left tower with compact supports
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and Noetherian scheme S, the explicit left tower L_d of [def-amb-affine-space-adjunction-tower] is naturally isomorphic to ordinary unbounded compact supports along X_d→S for every d.

source.place: Proof of cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction: successive affine-line projections and addition of twists

proof.text: For d=0 the projection is an isomorphism, hence etale. Apply the graph-normalized etale compact-support comparison, oriented from sum extension to compact supports.

For d+1 take the compactification consisting of the open chart j_d and proper projective-line projection q_d. Compactification independence identifies Rq_d* Dj_d! with compact supports along j_d q_d. Whisker the induction isomorphism, reassociate, apply unbounded compact-support composition, and use the coordinate projection identity.

proof_origin.place: Proof of cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction, expanded into the explicit coordinate tower.

theorem nonempty_ambientTowerLeftComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (d : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (ambientTowerLeft A S d ≅
      rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ambientAffine S d ↘ S))
